julesThoughtProcess: Chose a vibrant, warm amber (#FFB703) to evoke the golden-hour sunlight filtering through a high-tech city, perfectly matching the 'grounded optimism' and slice-of-life resilience requested.
storyPanel: The solar sails above District 4 catch the last light of the day, casting a warm amber glow over the crowded street market. Here, the hum of hover-bikes blends with the chatter of humans and droids haggling over salvaged parts. A seasoned mechanic wipes oil from her brow and shares a nod with a newly minted AI delivery bot. Life is noisy, messy, and requires constant upkeep, but there's a shared rhythm to it all—a stubborn, collective refusal to let the spark fade.
